normalization.overview: The video argues that skill sprawl harms agent performance and recommends pruning copied procedures.
normalization.whyItMatters: Installed file count, discoverable metadata and selected bodies have distinct costs and failure modes.
normalization.ghostMeshTakeaway: Measure discovery and selection accuracy before pruning; protect rare critical procedures.
normalization.falsification: Compare identical tasks across the same harness with controlled skill discovery sets, repeat runs, selection correctness, tokens, latency and error rate.
normalization.freshness: Verified private source pack with 803 timed ASR cues; deletion gains not independently replicated.

claims.proposition: Deleting 80–90% of installed skills improves agent performance.
claims.assessment: The source provides advice, not a controlled causal comparison across harnesses.
claims.limits: Deletion percentage cannot be treated as a validated target.
